title: Parliament Definitively Adopts €36bn Military Spending Boost
detail: The National Assembly gave final approval to the updated military programming law (loi de programmation militaire), voting 375 in favor to 113 against on a Senate-Assembly compromise text. The update adds €36 billion in additional defense investment through 2030, bringing total planned military spending to €436 billion — aiming to push the defense budget toward 2.5% of GDP. Priorities include replenishing missile stocks, expanding drone and counter-drone capabilities, and accelerating procurement in response to the war in Ukraine and broader European security concerns. President Macron was expected to sign the bill into law around Bastille Day.

media.caption: French parliament backs nearly $500 billion military spending plan
